senses.definition: an ancestor of David, Ru 4:19(×2), brother of Jerachmeel 1 Ch 2:9, 10.
son of J. 1 Ch 2:25, 27.—Αρραν, Ραμ, etc.
name of Elihu’s family, Jb 32:2 (Ραμ[α], Αραμ), dub., cf. Bu.
